newsitem.title: MEXICO: Alfa's Fibras Quimicas secures 5-yr loan.
newsitem.headline: Alfa's Fibras Quimicas secures 5-yr loan.

text.p: Fibras Quimicas SA, a unit of Alfa petrochemical subsidiary Alpek and Holland's Akzo Nobel, said on Tuesday it obtained a $75 million, five-year credit from a grooup of international banks led by Santander Investment.
The loan will pay interest at the London interbank offered rate (Libor) plus 150 basis points. The company will use the funds to refinance more costly debt.
Fibras Quimicos is one of Mexico's largest producers of synthetic fibers. In 1996 it expects sales of $265 million, of which $150 million will consist of exports, the statement said.
